This is sand leveling, or topdressing. It creates a more level surface for your lawn by filling in low areas. I use masonry sand since I have Bermuda grass. If you have a cool season grass type, a screened topsoil may be better. I like to put a little fertilizer down prior to, and after to ensure bermuda is growing aggressively through the sand. I water every other day for a week and within 2 weeks it should be almost fully recovered. Part 2 update coming soon #lawn #lawncare #lawnleveling #topdressing #diy #landscaping #howto

Hydroseeding is the future of grass planting and @liquidgreenhydroseeding is pioneering the industry. They use a specialized hydroseeding machine that sprays a mix of grass seed, mulch, fertilizer, and nutrients evenly across the ground. The layer locks in moisture, speeds up germination, and transforms dry soil into a lush green lawn within weeks — no digging required. Perfect for covering large areas. I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it!
